name: SNK retroactive referral reward accounting
summary: SNKMiner.dynamicEarned() multiplied a parent's accumulated reward-per-token delta by its children's current staked balance. A newly bound child could therefore stake after the delta accrued and retroactively increase the parent's reward; repeating that sequence produced excess SNK that the attacker sold into the SNK/USDT pool.

loss.notes: The exploit receipt contains one USDT transfer involving the SNK/USDT pair: exactly 197,725.727895542134092738 USDT leaves the pair for attacker beneficiary 0x7738b2f18d994c7c8fa10e1fe456069624740f3e. The attacker financed and repaid the separate SNK leg; there is no attacker-supplied USDT pair inflow to subtract. USDT is valued at par.

ageReset.description: SNKMiner was deployed with the referral contract, reward token, staking token, active reward interval, and nonzero reward rate used by the defective dynamicEarned() path. A later setPool call halved the already-active reward rate without installing, selecting, or enabling the child-balance logic, so it did not reset defect age.

sources.note: Reviewed the setup and exploit receipts and call traces, verified SNKMiner source, deployment and configuration history, direct runtime history and disassembly, exact token flows, and the commit-pinned reproduction. Setup transaction 0xace112925935335d0d7460a2470a612494f910467e263c7ff477221deee90a2c executes 49 target frames, all stake(uint256); it establishes parent positions but does not claim the defective reward. The anchor trace contains 1,820 frames and executes SNKMiner 225 times: 45 each of privateEarned(address), bindParent(address), stake(uint256), getReward(), and exit(). It is the first successful defect exercise and drain. The 8,499-byte direct runtime hashes to 0x11eb6f688fb7066ea9e1e0ea392e41a9b37083de3713d2eddd11c61bdc421da9 at deployment block 24270221 and pre-exploit block 28074092, and makes no target-originated DELEGATECALL. Its only 0xff byte is at program counter 8457 inside the unreachable 50-byte compiler metadata tail beginning at 8447; verified source has no self-destruct path. One later StartPool event, transaction 0xca286478351cc96d9d7d2d2f16db5d0d52efc53c7f917e0c4c445fb4e57ce225, preserves the existing start and stop times and halves rewardRate. It changes exploit magnitude but does not activate or select the already-live defective logic, so deployment remains the reset and code age is 11,523,088 seconds. The exploit receipt transfers exactly 197,725.727895542134092738 USDT from the SNK/USDT pair to the attacker beneficiary.
